name: first-use
source: Hand-written from ADR 0230, Decision: firstOpenedAt is recognized as exact text, separate from legacy startDate and unknown case variants.

name: unicode-separators
source: Hand-written decoded text from ADR 0230 and ADR 0200, Verification: explicit Unicode escapes preserve every supplied separator and ordinary LF in record strings and unknown keys.

name: minimal
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090, The record's shape. The two required keys alone give a Record with only its version.

name: ada
source: The worked record of ADR 0090, in the form the encoder writes, with the shared fixture contracts/record/testdata/ada.record.json as the expected value. Contract rule: Reading the file.

name: key-order
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Style is free: a comment, a leading ---, flow style, single quotes, any key order, a plain date in startDate, and no final newline. 0030: plans decode leniently, and a record is read the same way.

name: no-final-newline
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Style is free: a file need not end in a newline.

name: kind-quoted
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A single-quoted record is the text record.

name: kind-double-quoted
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A double-quoted record is the text record, and kind may come first or last.

name: strings
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Scalars and Known fields: quoted text stays text, a plain date and a plain timestamp are text, a plain deferred is text, block scalars are text. The outcome word is not validated, so Verified is kept as written.

name: answers
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Values, read in the record's answers: a plain deferred is Deferred, a quoted one is text, true is a Flag, a list of strings is a List, an empty list is a List with no items, and a null scope is an empty map. ADR 0090: a record's answers have the shape of a plan's.

name: answers-null
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Known fields: a null answers is the zero Answers.

name: answers-empty-map
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Known fields: an answers that is an empty map holds neither map, so it is the zero Answers.

name: answers-plan-only
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Known fields: an absent sections map stays nil.

name: answers-sections-null
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Known fields: a present empty plan map is not nil, and a null sections map is nil.

name: outcomes-edges
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Outcomes. The list keeps its order and its repeats, an empty map is a zero Outcome, and an outcome word is not validated. ADR 0085 sorts outcomes in the recorder, not in the decoder.

name: zero-and-null
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Known fields. A null or empty account, startDate, plan, answers, and outcomes are the zero values.

name: plan-partial
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Plan reference. Each key is read alone and none is filled in from another. An empty answers is the zero Answers, and an outcome with only a note is read as it stands.

name: plan-empty-map
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Plan reference. An empty plan map is the zero PlanReference.

name: unknown-fields
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090: unknown fields are kept and written back, and a record has no sections, variables, directory, origin, or provenance, so those keys and a key such as id are kept as unknown fields and not refused. Keys are exact, so Account and startdate are unknown. Numbers keep their kind: 2 is int64 and 2.0 is float64.

name: invalid-utf8
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: the bytes are not UTF-8.

name: empty-file
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: an empty file. The record decoder uses the code file.not-a-record.

name: comments-only
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a file of comments is empty.

name: lone-marker
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a lone --- is empty.

name: top-level-list
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: the top level is not a map.

name: multiple-documents
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a second document.

name: syntax-error
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a YAML syntax error.

name: syntax-error-in-second-document
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a syntax error in any document wins over the second-document problem.

name: complex-key
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Style is free: a key that is not a scalar is a wrong type at the path of the map that holds it, here the top level.

name: version-absent
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Version. The kind is not checked when the version is bad.

name: version-quoted
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Version: a quoted version is invalid.

name: version-zero
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Version: an integer below 1.

name: version-too-new
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Version: a newer file is the only problem. The file also has kind plan and a plain yes, and neither is reported.

name: version-duplicate
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Version: two schemaVersion keys.

name: version-before-kind
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Order of checks. The version is checked before the kind, so a bad version with kind plan reports only the version.

name: alias-on-version
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Version: an anchor on a good version is an alias problem.

name: kind-absent
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090: the decoder requires kind. A file with no kind is a plan to a reader of plans, so it is refused here.

name: kind-null
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A null kind is missing.

name: kind-empty
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A kind with nothing after the key is missing.

name: kind-plan
source: Hand-written. ADR 0090, The record's name and marker: the decoder refuses a file of the wrong kind with a message that says which it is. A plan file is the only problem, and its sections and the plain yes are not read.

name: kind-wrong-case
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. The text must be exactly record.

name: kind-blank
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A quoted empty string is text, and it is not record.

name: kind-trailing-space
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. The text is not trimmed.

name: kind-spelling
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A kind is judged by its text, so a plain yes is the text yes and not a spelling problem.

name: kind-number
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A plain 1 is the text 1.

name: kind-list
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. A kind that is not a scalar has an empty found.

name: kind-alias
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. An alias in place of the kind is not followed, and the anchor elsewhere is not reported because the kind problem is the only problem.

name: kind-duplicate
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. Two kind keys are a duplicate key, whatever their values, and it is the only problem.

name: kind-duplicate-values
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. Two kind keys are judged as a duplicate and not by the value of the first or the last.

name: kind-anchor
source: Hand-written. Contract rule: Kind. An anchor on a good kind is an alias problem, and the file is read on.

name: boolean-spelling
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems and Scalars: a plain yes, ON, n, Off, TRUE, or y where a string or a Value is read. The record's string fields are account, startDate, the plan reference, and the outcome keys.

name: number-spelling
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Numbers: a canonical integer where a string is read is a number spelling, and so are 1e3 and 007. A hash or an account that looks like a number is quoted in a file.

name: null-spelling
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Scalars: ~, Null, and NULL.

name: alias
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: an anchor on a value, an anchor on a map, an alias, a merge key, and an anchor on a list item are each reported at their node, and the merge key at its key.

name: duplicate-key
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a repeated key in the top level, the plan reference, an answer map, an outcome, and an unknown field.

name: wrong-type
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a list or a plain true where a string belongs, a list or text where a map belongs, and an outcome that is text or a list.

name: wrong-type-containers
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Values and Known fields: an answers map that is a list, a scope that is text, an answer that is a map, a list holding a list, and an outcomes that is a map.

name: unknown-field
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Unknown fields: the plan reference, the answers, and an outcome cannot keep unknown fields, and the value of an unknown key is not read, so the plain yes inside answers.extra is not reported. Keys are exact.

name: unknown-field-guards
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Unknown fields: the format guards apply inside an unknown field of the record.

name: empty-values
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: a null answer is empty-answer, and a null item in a List Value or in the outcomes list is empty-item.

name: problem-order
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: problems come in file order, so a file with its keys out of canonical order reports out of canonical order.

name: same-place
source: Hand-written. Plan decoder rule, Problems: two problems at one place come in the order of the table, so a spelling comes before an alias and a duplicate key before a wrong type.
